is one of the lines constructed in Period 5, as well as the Continuous Development Phase of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It currently has 33 stations, and is a south-north oriented line connecting Egress with Yowah, Punctual, Oasis and Oasis Bay.

History

This line was originally planned to be a connecting line between Punctual and northern Yowah, with termini being set up at Kelper Mount and Xylog Cliff, with space reserved for extension to Torrent. However, the appearance of in Friendly Railways and in Arcgo City Railway caused drastic changes to development plans.

While the modified plans did not alter any stations between Prosand and Yowah North, the termini of this line has been changed to Compahills and Unbalanced Bay, causing this line to become the connecting line between Yowah and South Egress.

After Phase I development was complete, the original plans involved extending to a terracotta mesa in north Egress <!--(Currently the location of Los Sengas International and Intergalactic Transport Hub (SITH))-->, but after repeated changes and due to geological constraints, the plans have been modified to connect this line to Egress Town Center and provide a north-south express service in east Los Sengas.

To the south of Compahills, completion of Oasis Bay Development also menat that feasibility studies could now be conducted regarding the southern extension of Hook Sand Line to Oasis Bay, and final plans saw this line using Charm River as the terminus.

title: Huntington
safeHtml:
'''Huntington''', formerly named '''Blufield ''', is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Southeasterly Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-13.

History

The name of this Sub-District originates from the fact that it was the resting place for many Expedition Parties who tried to map the Ingress Continent, and with the increase in the number of Hunters and Expedition Parties, this area eventually gave birth to the name of Huntington. The former name of this District, Blufield, also stemmed from the fact that rivers passing through this area would have its water turn into a pristine blue color.

Huntington was formerly planned to be a Commercial District, but ultimately became a scientific research area due to replanning, and is also one of the Sub-Districts with the most job opportunities in Asylum. The Developer of Asylum also had plans to reserve stations for at the east of Huntington for the convenience of commuters. However, after Nazca Railway released plans for the Ingress Continent in the 2024 Development Plans, it was revealed that would take a detour to the east, and this plan was also scrapped.
